title: SEC3: FetchBlobError mixes validation failures with runtime errors
description:
FetchBlobError enum (lines 304-322 in peer_fetch.rs) groups HostRejected and BlobIdInvalid (validation errors that should fail before network I/O) alongside Timeout and Network (transient failures).

In blob_download_handler (lib.rs lines 253-255), HostRejected/BlobIdInvalid map to 403 Forbidden, which is semantically odd for validation failures (400 Bad Request is clearer).

Refactor: Separate validation errors (BlobIdInvalid) from runtime errors. Consider Result<T, enum { Validation(String), Runtime(RuntimeError) }> to allow different error handling policies.
